decisions.reason: The internal-link instruction is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Specifying 3-4 images for the stuffed dolls blog does not change the existing publication condition requiring images and internal links before publication.
The image-count instruction does not change the selected blog keywords.
The source concerns images and internal links for an existing article, not the workflow for suggesting or selecting blog topics.
The stuffed dolls blog image count does not alter the campaign keyword count, selection, or page mapping.
The request to insert images in a blog does not change the webpage replacement text requirement.
Internal links and blog images are distinct from the off-page backlink creation requirement.
Requesting 3-4 blog images does not state that their ALT attributes must be added or otherwise change the separate ALT optimization requirement.
